title: Priority Pickup Price List, Wayfare Rides
content:
Priority Pickup is an add-on to a request on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**. Whether it is offered, and its price, depend on the ride option.

| Ride option | Priority Pickup offered | Priority Pickup charge |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Shared | No | $0.00 |
| Wayfare Standard | Yes | $2.99 |
| Wayfare Green | Yes | $2.99 |
| Wayfare Comfort | Yes | $3.99 |
| Wayfare XL | Yes | $3.99 |
| Wayfare Black | No | $0.00 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | No | $0.00 |

- **Priority Pickup offered**: whether Priority Pickup can be added to the request (true/false).
- **Priority Pickup charge**: charge for Priority Pickup, USD; $0.00 where not offered.

Priority Pickup is offered on Wayfare Standard and Wayfare Green at $2.99 and on Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL at $3.99; it is not offered on Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV.
